from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.adjustments import outage_refund
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly import audit
T0=datetime(2026,10,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def mk(): return Payment("p","i",Decimal("80.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)
p=mk(); assert outage_refund(p,Decimal("80.00"),T0) is p; assert p.status=="refunded"
p=mk()
for bad in (Decimal("0"),Decimal("-1")):
    try: outage_refund(p,bad,T0); raise SystemExit("fail")
    except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="non_positive_amount"
try: outage_refund(p,Decimal("81.00"),T0); raise SystemExit("fail")
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="refund_exceeds_captured"
p2=Payment("p2","i",Decimal("80.00"),status="authorized",created_at=T0)
try: outage_refund(p2,Decimal("1.00"),T0); raise SystemExit("fail")
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="invalid_state"
p=mk()
try: outage_refund(p,Decimal("1000.01"),T0); raise SystemExit("fail")
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="approval_required"
outage_refund(p,Decimal("1000.00"),T0) if False else None
p3=Payment("p3","i",Decimal("2000.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)
outage_refund(p3,Decimal("1000.00"),T0)
outage_refund(p3,Decimal("1000.01"),T0,approved_by="mgr")
assert p3.status=="refunded"
p4=mk(); audit.clear()
outage_refund(p4,Decimal("5.00"),T0,idempotency_key="k1")
outage_refund(p4,Decimal("5.00"),T0,idempotency_key="k1")
assert p4.refunded_amount==Decimal("5.00")
print("ok")
EOF"}
